feeds.title: ERA Architects
feeds.description: On ERA Architects Blog, read articles on heritage conservation, cultural engagement, democratic design, and values-based city & community building.

feeds.title: Åvontuura
feeds.description: Åvontuura is an online travel blog providing inspiration, opinions, and MUST-SEE city guides for architects, designers, travelers, and creative-minded people.

feeds.title: Keystone Architecture
feeds.description: Stay up to date with the latest architecture news, information, resources, and updates on our blog. At Keystone, our mission is to become a leading architectural firm in creative design solutions that resolve our clients' social, environmental & economic needs. We believe in creating solutions-driven developments of lasting value.

feeds.title: Architecture Next
feeds.description: A three-year master of architecture program is designed for people who have an undergraduate degree in a subject other than architecture. The purpose of the Architecture Next blog is to raise awareness of the three-year master of architecture program.

feeds.title: Architecture Lab
feeds.description: The goal of Architecture Lab is to make architecture more connected and bring together architects/designers from around the world searching for the latest architectural news: projects, products, events, interviews, and competitions among others.

feeds.title: Azrieli School of Architecture and Urbanism
feeds.description: Azrieli School of Architecture and Urbanism aims to be a resourceful place for anyone interested in architecture and urbanism. Read highlights of the event held or happening at the school, read achievement news of the profs, reunion & reward ceremonies, and other annual events.

feeds.title: Measured Architecture
feeds.description: Measured Architecture is a Vancouver-based studio practice focused on modern design, interiors, and landscapes. We practice situational modernism - a subject-based, humanist approach that considers a project through the aspirations of a client, the opportunities of a site, and the constraints of a municipality, budget, and schedule.

feeds.title: Canadian Architect
feeds.description: Canadian Architect is a magazine for architects and related professionals practicing in Canada. Canada's only monthly design publication, Canadian Architect has been in continuous publication since 1955. This national review of design and practice documents significant architecture and design from across the country and features articles on current practice, building technology, and social issues affecting architecture.

feeds.title: SpruceLab Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the SpruceLab blog, where we share our thoughts on relationships with the land, and decolonizing land-based practices. SpruceLab Inc. is a transdisciplinary planning and landscape architecture consultancy. We specialize in regenerative nature-based solutions and engagement to create resilient, healthy places and communities.

feeds.title: Cornerstone Architecture
feeds.description: Cornerstone Architecture has broad experience in a range of building types for both public and private clients. We are experienced in the process of analyzing existing conditions, developing the program of requirements, identifying opportunities, and testing alternate strategies. We provide a full range of architectural services.

feeds.title: Chernoff Thompson Architects Blog
feeds.description: Chernoff Thompson Architects blog page features the latest news about our company, awards, completed projects, and how we are helping our community. Chernoff Thompson Architects Vancouver based, and specialize in innovative, holistic design solutions for Post-Secondary Education, Civic, Corporate, and Public Sector Clients.

feeds.title: Canada Constructed Blog
feeds.description: Housed in the Department of Art History at the University of Toronto, this new initiative offers undergraduate courses, experiential learning, and internships in the field of the architecture and landscapes of Canada.

feeds.title: Cutler
feeds.description: Explore our insights on design, architecture, and how we connect people with places, spaces, and brands through creative design. At Cutler, we create environments that inspire human and brand connections. We are a team of creatives specializing in Architecture and Interior Design services. We connect people with places, spaces, and brands through creative design.

feeds.title: Brandon Donnelly
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Brandon G. Donnelly. I studied architecture and fine art history at the University of Toronto. I have over 15 years of real estate experience and am known for my creative, design-forward, and detailed-oriented approach to development. I am an architect-trained and tech-obsessed real estate developer. This is my daily blog for city builders.

feeds.title: Conexiam Blog
feeds.description: We share our success stories, crash and burn stories along with our approach to enterprise architecture and professional development. Conexiam is a vanguard enterprise architecture consulting organization.

feeds.title: EVOQ Architecture
feeds.description: EVOQ is an award-winning architecture firm recognized for quality interventions and site-sensitive design solutions. We specialize in heritage conservation and Inuit and First Nations architecture, with additional expertise in residential and commercial projects, heritage planning, and more.
